title: French Macaron Dark Ganache Shells
hookLine: Smooth glossy almond meringue shells with ruffled feet and velvety dark chocolate ganache.

items.name: Superfine blanched almond flour + powdered sugar
Room-temp egg whites + 1/3 cup caster sugar

steps.title: Preheat Oven & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line your baking pan with parchment paper, leaving a slight overhang for effortless lifting. Measure out {almond_mc} and {whites_mc} so everything is ready and at room temperature for a silky, lump-free batter.

steps.title: Fold Until Ribbon Lava Consistency
steps.instructionTemplate: Whip {whites_mc} to stiff glossy peaks, then fold in sifted {almond_mc} until batter flows off the spatula like thick molten ribbon.

steps.title: Bake French Macaron Dark Ganache Shells & Check Doneness
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake for 14 minutes until the edges turn golden and set while the center remains tender. Test with a toothpick—if it comes out with a few moist crumbs rather than wet batter, it is ready.

steps.title: Rest 30m Until Dry & Bake
steps.instructionTemplate: Pipe 1.5-inch rounds, tap tray to pop bubbles, rest 30 mins until dry to the touch, then bake at 300°F (150°C) for 14 mins. Sandwich with {ganache_mc}!
steps.criticalTip: Don't skip resting until a dry skin forms—that's what creates classic macaron feet.
steps.creatorSecret: Let the tray rest 5 minutes on the counter after baking so edges crisp while centers stay bakery-soft.

ugcQuotes.quote: Turned out bakery-grade on my first try! Ready in 39 mins.
